# PebelAI - AI Interview Coach & Job Search Platform

## About
PebelAI is an AI-powered career platform for Indian job seekers. It combines three core features:
1. AI Interview Coach - Practice mock interviews with voice AI, get performance reports
2. Job Search Portal - Find jobs matched to your resume from Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed
3. Application Tracker - Track every job application in one organized dashboard

## Core Features
- Voice-based AI mock interviews (behavioral, technical, case study, salary negotiation)
- Live Interview Room - Google Meet-style interview simulation with AI interviewer
- Resume upload with AI parsing (skills, experience, education extraction)
- AI job matching - resume analyzed against real job listings from Indian job boards
- Application tracking with pipeline view (Applied → Interviewing → Offer)
- Smart reminders for follow-ups and interviews
- Post-interview performance report with scores, strengths, weaknesses, improvement tips

## Target Users
- Indian job seekers (freshers, professionals, experienced candidates)
- Students preparing for campus placements
- Professionals switching jobs
- Anyone preparing for technical or behavioral interviews

## Technology
- Next.js 16 frontend deployed on Vercel
- FastAPI Python backend deployed on Render
- Supabase PostgreSQL database
- Groq AI (Llama 3.3 70B) for interview coaching
- Web Speech API for voice recognition
- Job data from LinkedIn, Indeed India, Adzuna, Remotive

## Pricing
Free to use. No credit card required.
